current.text: He is a projected starter for the Spurs next to Fox, Castle, Harris and Wembanyama.
He is entrenched in the rotation, but in a reduced, lower-usage role.
He showed defense and shot blocking in the postseason.
The Spurs roster is very deep at guard and forward. The team plans more three-guard lineups with Fox, Castle and Harper.
He is not projected to be draftable because of the Spurs' depth.

durable.text: He is an all-around wing. He scores, shoots threes, rebounds, defends and works as a secondary playmaker.

tags.name: fits every build
tags.detail: No weak category flagged. Best value in threes and low turnovers. FG% is his weakest category.

tags.name: waiver watch
tags.detail: Ranked 128 (ESPN) to 157 (Yahoo), near the 144-player draft cutoff. Starter on a deep team.

note: Both sites price him at 1 USD or less (Yahoo value 0 USD, rank 157; ESPN rank 128), well below the 5 USD our league paid last season. He sits right around the 144-player cutoff, so at most he is a 1 USD last bench pick, and it is fine to leave him on waivers. His projected line is modest in every category, with about 2.3 threes and 1.1 turnovers as his best spots and a 44% FG% as the weak spot. Early in the season, check whether three-guard lineups and the deep wing group keep his minutes below the 30.5 he played last season (ESPN projects 27.5).
